meta: Write Facebook posts with AI without sounding like a machine: AI posts give themselves away with clichés and emojis everywhere.

muc.title: You can tell AI wrote it
muc.text: Facebook posts written by AI are easy to spot: empty clichés and emojis scattered everywhere.

muc.title: Tell AI to write like you talk
muc.text: Tell AI to write as if telling a friend: short sentences, everyday words, just one or two emojis.

muc.title: Cut the clichés
muc.text: Read the draft and cross out anything that sounds like an ad, especially the hype at the start and the call to action at the end.

muc.title: Add your own story
muc.text: Add one real detail from your day, like a meal or someone you met, and the post comes alive.

muc.title: Read it out loud
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for a draft post, read it out loud, and rewrite any sentence you'd never actually say.
